decision: Wave48 validly evaluates the seed-0 50/50 expert/replay hard-latent pilot and passes its promotion gate without establishing successful planning: target-free current-buffer GAR has positive first-step true advantage (0.50), improves mean selected true advantage over decisions 2-4 (0.09375 versus 0.02083) and full normalized edit-distance improvement (-1.237 versus -1.745) relative to the information-matched expert-only parent, while effective rank remains healthy (100.0 versus 103.6), but full trajectories remain destructive with 0/32 exact recoveries. Replicate the unchanged replay intervention at seeds 1 and 2. Treat expert-state coverage as a reproducible contributor only if at least two of the three seeds, including seed 0, have positive first-step true advantage, exceed the fixed seed-0 expert-only parent on both decisions-2-to-4 mean advantage and full normalized edit-distance improvement, retain state effective rank above 50 and state standard deviation above 0.1, and produce all declared artifacts without NaNs. If this gate fails, stop scaling the present replay/GAR recipe. If it passes, do not claim planning success or seed-scale further; isolate the post-decision-4 degradation with a matched short-horizon control. Proposal generation, behavior actions, GAR scores, and selection are target-free; terminal targets are used only for training labels and separately labelled evaluation metrics.
